warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared upcoming RFQ summary instead of creating or searching for an event.
Enable eRFX projects as required for the upcoming RFQ scenario.
Navigate to the RFQ stage page where its Settings menu is available.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu.
Verify the action is offered and enabled for the upcoming RFQ.
Click the enabled action to open its time-extension window.
Confirm the action opens the Increase Event Time window before any confirmation.
Cancel the window so no submission time change is committed.
Verify the cancel action closes the window without applying a change.
